value.rationale: This is a complete and motivated inverse shape classification for independently surface-sampled Euclidean chords on cones. The precise two-to-one interval and its fixed-point transition quantify measurement nonidentifiability; the sixth moment uniquely resolves every ambiguous pair and the contrast has a sharp global inverse Lipschitz constant. No unsupported general downstream theorem or finite-sample guarantee is claimed.
